variants.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Chinese video thumbnail/cover for the independent browser extension 喵咛文本窗, landscape 16:9, requested exact 1920×1080 full bleed composition. Input image 1 is the authoritative character identity reference, not a screenshot to paste wholesale. Input image 2 is only the authentic plugin UI visual reference; discard the surrounding testing page and its technical labels. Maintain the black cat's instantly recognizable face: rounded black head, triangular black ears with dark pink inner ears, low half-lidded ivory eyes, deadpan unimpressed expression, tiny pink nose and ivory muzzle, round black paws and red scarf accent. Same mascot as the reference, not a generic cute blue-eyed cat. A waist-up pose only so no invented costume is needed.
Creative direction A: “give the prompt room to breathe”. A restrained, polished Bilibili creator-tool cover with huge bold Chinese editorial typography and a delightful oversized mascot; warm ivory background, charcoal interface strip, warm vermilion red accents, tiny muted sage accent. No noisy texture, no particles, no glowing science fiction, no icon soup.
Exact prominent headline in two lines at left, very large, beautifully typeset and readable at small thumbnail size: “提示词” / “别挤着写”. “别挤着写” is the strongest line, can use warm red for one phrase. Smaller brand text “喵咛文本窗” at top left. A small secondary line at bottom left: “放大编辑 · 拖动缩放”. Do not include any other marketing copy.
On the right and lower center, show a large crisp floating text-editor window with a dark header, an ivory document and a warm-red 确认 button inspired by input image2. A large black cat leans over its upper right corner, one round paw holding a window corner and the other proudly showing the beige board with the vivid red checkmark from its reference. A tiny cramped source text box behind the expanded one and one simple diagonal resize handle communicate expansion; do not use a split-screen or a busy infographic. Only 2-3 short horizontal lines of text in the document, never dense technical UI. Cat expression remains half-lidded, with a subtly confident pose. Ensure paws are anatomically clear with no duplicate limbs.
Composition: headline owns approximately left 48%, character and window own right 52%, ample spacing, not a screenshot collage. Everything sits within 5% safe margins. Strong dark/light separation. No platform logos other than the requested own brand, no watermark, no claims about universal website support or AI generation. Professionally finished, flat graphic editorial composition with softly shaded 2.5D mascot matching the original.

variants.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Chinese Bilibili video thumbnail for the browser extension 喵咛文本窗, landscape EXACT 16:9, preferred 1920 × 1080 PNG. This is cover concept C about referring to images by typing their names and pressing Tab.
Input image 1 is the authoritative character identity reference, NOT a texture to merely paste: retain this exact original black cat IP with rounded black short-haired head, pointed ears, sleepy half-lidded annoyed eyes, ivory muzzle, tiny pink nose, red scarf accent, chunky round dark paws. Enlarge and redraw faithfully as the same character in a polished outlined illustration. Input image 2 is only the authentic plugin UI and palette reference.
Art direction: striking premium creator-tool cover, highly legible at thumbnail size, clean deep charcoal background, enormous warm ivory Chinese headline, muted warm red accent and a little desaturated sage. No neon futuristic effects, no grain, no fragments, no decorative clutter. Only three meaningful visual groups. Headline about 40%, cat about 35%, clear interaction about 20%. Crisp printlike shapes and restrained dimensional shadows.
Composition: left half enormous bold typographic two-line headline reading EXACTLY:
“打出图名”
“Tab 就引用”
Set Tab in a strong warm-red rounded keyboard-key treatment while keeping second line readable. Small brand near top left EXACT “喵咛文本窗”. Smaller explanatory badge beneath headline EXACT “灰色预览 · Tab 确认”.
On right, a very large waist-up faithful black cat with half-closed unimpressed eyes, cream muzzle and red scarf presses one broad physical Tab keycap with one chunky paw; paw anatomy natural, no extra fingers. Cat and key dominate, whole face and ears remain inside safe margins.
Lower middle contains one compact simplified floating editor card consistent with authentic screenshot: charcoal top strip and cream body. A clean brief sequence shows plain text “测试1”, then muted grey “@ 测试1”, then a confirmed compact image-reference pill containing a simple turquoise circle thumbnail and “@ 测试1”. Use two thin small arrows to show this progression. Make the GREY middle preview visually inactive and the final reference pill active in restrained sage, so the feature is honest. This UI illustration is clearly simplified, no fake extra settings or irrelevant UI.
All Chinese must be flawless and exactly match above, especially 喵咛文本窗 and 引用. Do not add any additional slogans, watermarks, English branding, claims of universal platforms, generated video, cloud backup, or numerical promises. Keep generous outer safe area; no cropping of text, ears, paws or keycap. Opaque background. Deliver ONE single full finished thumbnail image, not a contact sheet.
